summary: Deploy a curated/user template as a new live dashboard: resolves template variables (defaults + overrides), substitutes {key}/{{key}} into each step's params, and creates DashboardCards.

params.name: template_slug
params.doc: Slug of an is_active template to deploy. Required.

params.name: dashboard_title
params.doc: Custom dashboard title; defaults to template.title.

params.name: variables
params.doc: Key/value overrides merged on top of template defaults. ALL keys are applied (not just declared vars). Special default forms: 'today' -> today's ISO date; '-Nd' -> N days ago ISO.

returns: { success: true, dashboard_id, title, live_url, manage_url, cards_created, template_used, note } | {error,error_type?,message,...}

summary: Save a set of query steps as a reusable 'user' template (always min_tier='pro'); generates a slugified id with random suffix.

params.name: description
params.doc: What the template does. Required (positional, no default).

params.name: steps
params.doc: Non-empty list (<=20) of step dicts; each MUST have a 'tool' key. Element type: object. Required.

params.name: required_platforms
params.doc: List of platform keys (array of strings) that must be connected. Required.

params.name: variables
params.doc: Optional list of variable-definition dicts (array of objects). Stored as [] if omitted.

params.name: icon
params.doc: Optional icon slug; defaults to the category value.

returns: { success: true, template_id, slug, title, category, steps: <int count>, browse_url, note } | {error,error_type?,message}
